Geist and Geist Mono (Vercel, SIL Open Font License 1.1: OFL.txt), from the npm package geist@1.3.1
(dist/fonts/*/Geist*-Variable.woff2), cut down for the viewer with fontTools: weight axis limited to 400-700
(varLib.instancer) and subset to Latin-1, general punctuation, arrows and a few symbols (pyftsubset --flavor=woff2).
The license names no Reserved Font Name, so the modified fonts keep their names.
